name: osaas-e2e-test-app-build-failure
description: Fixture branch for osaas-e2e-tests#590: deterministically fails web-runner's build step so /healthz answers with the runner loading-server's terminal build-failure signature (HTTP 500 + {"status":"build-failed"}). See scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh in Eyevinn/web-runner: npm install failures are NOT checked (BUILD_EXIT stays 0), only a failing `build`/`build:app` script sets BUILD_EXIT non-zero. Do not revert this to a 'nonexistent dependency version' approach — that would NOT reproduce a build failure on this runner.
